improvements.message: Consider adding more advanced scoring criteria, such as sentiment analysis or audience retention metrics, to improve the scoring accuracy and relevance.
Enhance the filtering logic to support multi-select filters for categories, games, and streamers, which would improve usability for users managing large datasets.
Add IndexedDB support as an optional upgrade for handling larger datasets, as LocalStorage may become a bottleneck for scalability.
Include wireframes or mockups for the GUI to provide a clearer visual representation of the design.
Expand the documentation to include troubleshooting steps for common issues, such as importing invalid JSON or browser compatibility problems.

payload.quality_target: The project meets the stated requirements and provides a solid foundation for future enhancements. Improvements focus on advanced features and scalability.
